name: Ho’olei at Grand Wailea
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive Waldorf Astoria resort sits on Maui's coveted Wailea coastline, where ancient Hawaiian royalty once walked the same golden sands you'll call home.
whats_special: Ho'olei features just 117 spacious villas ranging from 1,400 to 2,800 square feet, each with ocean views and private lanais. The property sits adjacent to the legendary Grand Wailea resort, giving guests access to the famous 40,000-square-foot Spa Grande and the elaborate water wonderland featuring nine pools, water slides, and lazy river - all while maintaining an intimate, residential feel.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the upper floors for unobstructed views of Molokini Crater and the outer islands of Lanai and Kahoolawe, especially stunning during Maui's famous golden hour sunsets.
dont_miss: The resort's location on Wailea Beach - consistently ranked among the world's best beaches - offers perfect conditions for snorkeling, stand-up paddleboarding, and seasonal whale watching (December through April). The nearby Wailea Golf Club features three championship courses, including the Gold Course that's hosted PGA Tour events.
pros: Luxury villa-style accommodations with private lanais and ocean views
Access to Grand Wailea's world-class amenities including Spa Grande
Spacious multi-bedroom villas perfect for families and groups
Premium Maui location in Wailea with pristine beaches nearby
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive villa experience
Limited dining options within the villa property itself
